name: dayTickCountries
note: +0xADC/+0xAE0 country vector of the day tick

name: dateHours
note: date in hours, base 0x029C55C0 = year -5000; +0x18 per day; 365-day years, no leap years

name: firedOnceEvents
note: fire_only_once table; insert has no duplicate check and no rehash

name: flagB94
note: changes the GP vassal branch of AI_GetOpinionScore

name: timeBarrier
note: CMP at 0x00682D05; JZ 0x00682D0C skips temporal processing

name: marketCountries
note: +0xBD0/+0xBD4 country list used by the world market

name: tutorialMode
note: set to 1 by Tutorial_Start (0x0077B800); gates the AI bucket fill, the event scan and spatial registration; not a client flag

name: eventCandidates
note: +0x08/+0x0C; read by the daily event scan

name: aiObject
note: created on the host only (World_CreateAiObjects); null on clients; Event_Fire chooses AI options only when set

name: aiDailyDone
note: embedded AI state +0x18 (base 0x364): set by AI_DailyUpdate; Country_DailyUpdate skips the update when non-zero

name: aiSkipDiplomacy
note: embedded AI state +0x19; AI_DiplomacyUpdate returns when non-zero

name: technology
note: +0x2B8 tech state array indexed by tech+0x2E4

name: states
note: world market iterates states then +0x18 factories

name: valueIndex
note: CTagTrigger: country index of the literal tag

name: can_use
note: keyword 0x92A; evaluated by the daily scan

name: badboy_factor
note: x1000; +0xF8..+0x10C six more x1000 factors, order unconfirmed

name: flag1A1
note: 0 -> window may be suppressed by the UI manager

name: aiObjects
note: +0xA4/+0xA8/+0xAC; filled on the host only; walked by the AI bucket fill at the end of DayTick

name: worldRng
note: embedded MT19937; index +0xA74; seeded from the clock in World_ctor or from save token 0x7A4; read by AI_DailyRoll and AI frame code

name: syncVector
note: +0xB74/+0xB78/+0xB7C; [rngCalls, seed] written at tick start, copied into CHourlyTickCommand by the host, compared by every receiver (Vector_Equals at 0x00683036)

name: aiJobBuckets
note: +0xB84/+0xB88; 16-byte list headers, country % N; only bucket 0 is drained by AI_FrameUpdate

name: oosDialogShown
note: set once after the OOS dialog; never reset in a session

name: aiState
note: embedded per-country AI state passed to AI_DailyUpdate/AI_DailyRoll (EAX/EDI); +0xC country index, +0x10/+0x14 last update dates, +0x18 done, +0x19 skip diplomacy

name: money
note: treasury, 2^15 fixed point; Country_PrePass writes other countries too

name: popListsEnd
note: +0x194/+0x198 vector of 16-byte entries, one per pop type, +0 = first pop

name: playerId
note: session vt+0x44 at construction (+0x28 word: vt+0x48)

name: typeId
note: +0x2C/+0x30 (e.g. 0x32B hourly tick, 0x42F random seed, 0x430 pause, 0x41D start game, 0x158 file transfer)

name: tickStamp
note: set by the server from sessionMgr+0x54 when broadcasting

name: sendImmediately
note: non-zero: serialize and send at once instead of the batch ring

name: payload
note: first subclass field (hourly tick: the sync vector; pause: name string)

name: state
note: 0 idle, 3 error, 4 in game, 6 synching (state received), 9/0xD/0xE lobby and transfer, 0xB/0xC in-game variants

name: isServer
note: 1 in single player and for the host

name: newPeers
note: +0x70/+0x74/+0x78; filled on connect, drained by the lobbies

name: setupCommands
note: +0xD8/+0xDC/+0xE0; clones of executed commands whose vt+0x30 predicate returns 1; sent to every connecting peer (message 0x12)

name: receivedState
note: buffer of message 0x12 until SessionManager_FinishSync consumes it
